name: Get Sucked OR . . . RUNNNNN!!!
desc:
Get Sucked OR .... RUNNNNN!! is a fast paced speed survival game where powerful suction events appear with different strength levels, pulling everything toward them. Your goal? Build speed, outrun the pull, and reach the end!

🔥 FEATURES:

 🌪️ Dynamic Suction Events with multiple difficulty levels

 💨 Speed gain simply by moving

 🏆 Trophy Zones at the end of each area

 ⚙️ Trophy Upgrades to permanently increase your speed

 🚀 Rebirth System for faster progression and higher multipliers

 🎉 Chaotic, fun, and highly replayable

Can you outrun the suction and dominate every level? Jump in and prove it!
